result.summary: This is a signalized four-way intersection in a residential area featuring marked continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the wide crossing distance and lack of physical medians or refuge islands increase exposure to multi-lane traffic.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from vegetation
hazards.description: Dense trees and bushes at the corners may partially obscure pedestrians waiting to cross from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corners of the intersection, particularly the left and right foreground

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve the visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with standard pedestrian infrastructure including high-visibility zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and a concrete refuge island. However, the wide roadway and multiple travel lanes result in a significant crossing distance that increases pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic, increasing their time of exposure to potential vehicle conflicts.
hazards.location_in_image: The primary crosswalk spanning the multi-lane roadway in the foreground.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for relatively high-speed vehicle turns, which can endanger pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: The curb corners at the intersection.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to provide pedestrians with a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve the visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility continental crosswalks, curb ramps with tactile warning pads, and dedicated pedestrian signals. The environment is residential with mature street trees providing a buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

hazards.name: Wide turning radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows vehicles to make right turns at relatively high speeds, increasing the risk of conflict with pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground corner of the intersection

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance for pedestrians and physically slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Implement a signal timing change that gives pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals, providing a basic level of safety in a residential setting. However, the lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions or medians leaves pedestrians exposed during the crossing of the two-lane roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian refuge
hazards.description: The crossing distance across two lanes lacks a central refuge, increasing pedestrian exposure time to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Main crosswalk in the foreground across the intersection.
